clauses.zh: 融合带可能偏亮，暗场画面中重叠区域需经现场校正后才能完全消除。
clauses.en: Blend zones may look brighter; in dark scenes the overlaps are only fully removed after on-site calibration.

clauses.zh: 清晰度受像素尺寸限制（本项目约 {pixel_mm} mm），近距离观看时画面颗粒感明显。
clauses.en: Sharpness is limited by the pixel size (about {pixel_mm} mm on this wall); the pixels show when viewed up close.

clauses.zh: 天花过矮会影响吊装和机位，需要现场复核天花高度和吊点。
clauses.en: A low ceiling affects mounting and projector positions; the ceiling height and fixing points need a site check.

clauses.zh: 天花或建筑抖动可能导致融合错位，需定期校正。
clauses.en: Ceiling or building vibration can misalign the blend; recalibrate periodically.

clauses.zh: 本方案未取得{missing_drawings}，{affected_items}按手填值计算，需现场复核后确认。
clauses.en: The {missing_drawings} were not available; {affected_items} were calculated from values entered by hand and must be checked on site.
